rows.text: Bello does not merely attack; he animates non-Equipment artifacts and non-Aura enchantments with mana value 4 or greater into 4/4 indestructible, hasty Elementals that draw a card whenever they connect with an opponent's face. Crucially, they are only creatures on your turn, dodging opposing sorcery-speed removal entirely while surviving your own symmetrical sweepers like Jokulhaups, Obliterate, and Blasphemous Act because Bello grants them indestructible. Because they are creatures during your turn, untap effects like Aggravated Assault untap animated mana rocks like Thran Dynamo, Gilded Lotus, and Chromatic Orrery to trigger infinite combat loops.

Look for aggressive hands featuring 0-1 mana fast acceleration (Mox Diamond, Chrome Mox, Sol Ring, Mana Vault, or dorks) and at least one 4-drop artifact or enchantment. The ideal curve deploys fast mana on turn 1, casts Bello on turn 2, and drops a 4+ mana value artifact or enchantment on turn 3, immediately swinging for 4 indestructible damage and drawing a card. In Bracket 4, you do not need to wait until turn 6: assemble Aggravated Assault with Chromatic Orrery or Nature's Will as quickly as possible, or wipe the board with Jokulhaups or Obliterate while your animated army stands tall.
